explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/803: Alon proved that for every D > 1 and large n there is an n-vertex G with ≥ n log n edges in which every D-balanced subgraph H on m vertices has ≪ m√(log m) + log D edges. The statement gives one absolute C such that, for each D > 1 and all large n, such a G exists with e(H) ≤ C(m√(log m) + log D) for every D-balanced subgraph H. Faithful.
